# Current checkpoint

The user reports Max Sell All failing after Max Buy All and intermittent refreshes. This followup adds automatic transaction completion and balance updates, a manual refresh-all control, and stable submission and account recovery. Standing authorization includes shipping the tested change to the existing Hoodlabs project. Tests use inert wallets and controlled services, with no real funds or owner secrets. See contract.md.

The candidate is /home/tx/projects/hoodlabs-wallet-stability on fix/wallet-transaction-stability. Base and current remote main are 55ba8786895428e5579ffde889564c48cefd1f13. Financial changes are integrated at 76a4018. UI changes are integrated at c9bb16d and 97e0df0. Account recovery, financial epochs and final snapshot coalescing are integrated at 6b5aa58, from critical owner 846939a. The next documentation commit freezes this combined candidate. Its exact revision and all release results belong in artifacts/wallet-stability/evidence-manifest.json.

The actual-module roundtrip reproduced insufficient exit gas after Max Buy. A delayed 50-node batch previously submitted 24 of 50 before quote expiry. The reserve and bounded review renewal passed a separate delayed run with all 50 submitted in 141.454 seconds. This measures reliable completion under delay, not faster chain confirmation. Independent core checks passed on the earlier core source; the account guard changes require final affected verification again.

Actual browser fixtures reproduced absent status polling, a 2775-pixel forced scroll, and a final batch update replacing an earlier confirmation with pending state. The UI repair passed its corresponding regressions. Refreshes publish incrementally, retain newer hashes, coalesce requests, preserve outstanding reads across UI timeouts, and remain available before token holdings load. Native-balance refresh requests remain available when token holdings fail.

Two transient account failures reproduced loss of the loaded wallet. The new central gate preserves the same owner's wallet while suspending financial actions. Owner and action generations prevent interrupted preparation, reviews, batches and signing from resuming after recovery. Actual logout, identity/capability changes, malformed or fatal responses, pagehide and idle expiry still revoke. The workspace owner key excludes readiness. Exchange funding is suppressed during a pause; trade and bridge status remain visible. The older Sell All browser test is consolidated into the new account matrix with an explicit coverage mapping.

Producer checks at the account owner tip passed 109 focused financial tests, two real-time snapshot timeout tests, typecheck and three browser scripts. The delayed 50-node test was deliberately skipped in that focused run and must run separately on the final candidate. Preliminary independent account tests passed, but are not final-candidate evidence. Full tests, typecheck, production build, scanner, moderate audit, dedicated browsers, independent verification and fresh Astra High review remain required. Exact-commit hosted CI and deployment/live acceptance follow those gates.

The live anonymous account check passed before release. The current rollback target remains dpl_GtqD6LP9Bu9KEgzBs9XBhZ5q9wkR, hoodlabs-abc3m6pxh-tx-build.vercel.app. Preserve all existing production configuration and the separate hoodrich.rip/www deployment.
